recipes.title: Strawberry Honey Gummy Bears

items.i: strawberries, washed and hulled (or watermelon, green apple)
agar agar powder (1 tbsp per cup of purée)

steps: Blend the strawberries, lemon juice, honey and elderberry syrup until completely smooth.
Pour into a pot and whisk in 1 tbsp agar powder for every cup of purée. Cook on medium-high, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes until there are no clumps.
Turn the heat down and keep stirring for another 2 minutes. Take off the heat and keep stirring as it cools slightly so it doesn't set in the pot.
Use a dropper or syringe to fill gummy molds.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours (overnight is best), then pop them out.
recipes.notes: Amounts are from the video; agar quantity assumes about 3 cups of purée. Macros are estimates for 1/8 of the batch. Setting time not included. Not suitable for babies under 1 because of the honey — use maple syrup instead. Plant-based only with maple syrup.
